Exponential representation and delta method for (E,E³,E⁵) give centered P3/P5 joint Gaussian at n^(5/2), n^(9/2), with κ33=360, κ35=28800, κ55=3254400. Taylor expansion of sin with L² P7=O(n^-6) yields centered S=−(π³/6)P3~+(π⁵/120)P5~, A=−4(π³/6)P3~+16(π⁵/120)P5~. Exact least squares projection gives β_n=4−48π²n^-2+o(n^-2), projected n^(9/2) residual=(π⁵/10)(P5~−80n^-2 P3~)+o_L², covariance constant [3254400−160·28800+6400·360]/100=9504 times π^10. Since Var(A)~160π^6n^-5, regression identity gives 1−ρ~(297π⁴/10)n^-4; fixed slope4 variance 32544π^10, relative 33/113. Independently recalculated every κ and these constants exactly.
